achievements.name: Old Pickaxe
achievements.detail: Take the old pickaxe in the mine under Tumbleton and break the first blocks with it.

achievements.name: Ore Sale
achievements.detail: Carry ore back to Tumbleton and sell it for money.

achievements.name: Better Pickaxe
achievements.detail: Buy a stronger pickaxe in Tumbleton so harder soil can be dug.

achievements.name: Steam Jump
achievements.detail: Reach the steam jump upgrade in an Archaea cave and spend water on a leap higher than an ordinary jump.

achievements.name: Drill
achievements.detail: Take the drill from a cave in Archaea and bore through rock the pickaxe cannot break.

achievements.name: Teleporter
achievements.detail: Ride a mine teleporter back to Tumbleton instead of climbing the whole shaft.

achievements.name: Old World
achievements.detail: Dig to the bottom of Archaea and enter the Old World.

achievements.name: Dynamite
achievements.detail: Take the dynamite upgrade in an Old World cave and throw a stick to blow open a blockage.

achievements.name: Steam Punch
achievements.detail: Take the steam punch in an Old World cave and spend water on a charged hit that smashes blocks.

achievements.name: Larger Pouch
achievements.detail: Buy a larger pouch in Tumbleton so more ore can be carried before the next trip up.

achievements.name: Vectron
achievements.detail: Leave the Old World through its lowest door and enter Vectron.

achievements.name: Voltbot
achievements.detail: Defeat Voltbot in the lowest chamber of Vectron.
